text: The mayor's proposal to build a new convention center downtown is a waste of taxpayer money. Every other city that has tried this — look at St. Louis, Hartford, Baltimore — ended up with a white elephant that never generated the promised economic returns. We should invest that $500 million in fixing our crumbling schools instead of chasing the same failed dream that has burned cities across the country.

annotations.quote: Every other city that has tried this — look at St. Louis, Hartford, Baltimore — ended up with a white elephant
chasing the same failed dream that has burned cities across the country

metadata.note: The examples cited (St. Louis, Hartford, Baltimore) are real and genuinely illustrate the risk of convention center projects. The speaker could be cherry-picking failures while ignoring successes, or could be citing a representative pattern that urban economists have documented. The generalization is broad but not baseless — many convention centers have underperformed.
